method: All 11 original studio and six world images inspected. Ground-support report read after image inspection. Subjective scores; the same unresolved junction defect is not renamed as a new defect.

correctionResult.family: buried rectangular annex roof with independent barge adjustment
correctionResult.finding: Front and rear door-overlapping corbels are removed; front arch is now clearly unobstructed. However, after shortening the barge the closed clay roof slab itself still projects past the main left wall onto the upper front facade as a thin angled spike. This is visible in front-left, front-right, front, top and clay-front. The underlying original wall-junction defect remains, so the required +0.10 and >=0.89 are not achieved.
correctionResult.regressions: No new critical regression; roof sweep/enclosure, volumes and windows remain unchanged.

familyLedger.representation: buried rectangular annex roof with independently shortened trim
familyLedger.reason: Same dominant junction defect remains and gain is insufficient.

familyLedger.constraint: Generate slab, soffit, end caps and trim from the actual main-wall termination boundary. This changes the construction representation addressing the SAME defect. Preserve main roof, annex volume, openings, terrace, transforms and accepted corbel fix. R03 is the first gate; at most r04 is its one bounded correction. No third family within this gate.

nextAcceptance: No visible slab or trim spike across the front facade; closed roof-wall contact retained in all required views; architectural attachment at least 0.89 versus original 0.79 and every critical score at least 0.85, without regression over 0.05.

assembly.findings: Workroom threshold shrub is gone, improving entry 0.76 to 0.89 (+0.13). Main approach stays clear after prior crate/barrel move. Front/rear/elevated evidence retains separation from cottage02, cottage04 and guild. Rear sill remains unobstructed. No new foliage or ground intrusion visible.
assembly.supportAssessment: Nine terrain-only rays from above all terrain surfaces report support intersecting the terrace underside at every sample. Both outer rear samples are supported by ISLAND_22_TOP_TERRACE at world y=0.58 versus underside y=0.496, a 0.084 overlap. This resolves the earlier evidence hold and is consistent with the visual shelf. No extra footing is required by this evidence.
assembly.supersededEvidence: support-before.json is excluded: its ray origin was below enclosing support geometry.
assembly.limitations: World90 is fully occluded; world270 partly occluded. Assembly approval concerns placement/support/access, not the separate studio macro junction defect.

release: Finish remains withheld until family2 macro passes. Preserve rejected v002 and review counters.
remainingTargetGap: Macro only; no detailed finish expected. Exact inferred-reference identity is not claimed.
